title: nmr_bind_fit: transparent model comparison and uncertainty reporting for NMR host-guest titrations
description: nmr_bind_fit is a Python command-line workflow for NMR chemical-shift titration binding analysis. It fits 1:1, sequential 1:2, sequential 2:1, and non-binding candidate models, reports information-criterion model comparisons and bootstrap uncertainty, and generates reproducible analysis summaries for host-guest binding studies.
